# CANDIDATE: CHART_STOP_BUFFER_TIGHTEN_0.25

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the chart stop buffer for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON PUT entries will reduce losses on losing days by exiting earlier when the price moves against the trade, while preserving the ability to capture winners because the buffer remains wide enough to avoid normal intraday noise.

## Mechanism

For BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON PUT entries, the chart stop is triggered when SPY closes a 3-min candle above the rejected level + buffer. Currently the buffer is $0.50 (params.json#chart_stop_buffer_dollars). This candidate reduces the buffer to $0.25. Entry price, TP1 (+50% at 0.667 qty), runner, chandelier profit-lock, and time stop (15:50 ET) remain unchanged. The change is made exclusively in the PUT path of the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup.

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L (per OP-20 disclosure rule).
2. **Sample bias:** Full 16-month OPRA backtest (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) will be used; risk of overfit if tuned only to J anchor days; walk-forward OOS test required to mitigate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward test not yet run; WF ratio target >=0.70).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (realistic OPRA fill validation on top 3 J days not yet performed; must show <±20% diff vs BS sim).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: gap-up opening on a loser day triggers tight stop early, causing a loss that could exceed the original stop.
   - Max drawdown scenario: series of whipsaw stopouts on choppy days increases realized loss.
   - Blow-up scenario: buffer too tight causes frequent stopouts, turning winners into losers and eroding edge_capture.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.
